title: A new visual world for Dr Aloka's Eye Care (light, no kites)
question: Re-roll 1 assigned The Trial-Lens Case. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll again.

options.label: The Trial-Lens Case
options.lineage: the refraction trial set: rows of rimmed lenses in a lined case, slotted into a trial frame
options.thesis: The page comes into focus the way a child's sight does: each chapter is seen through a lens that slides in, and blur resolves to sharp.
options.viewport: Bright clinical white. A large round lens hovers right, magnifying the doctor's portrait behind it; the headline is soft-focus on load and snaps sharp as the lens settles. Book key under the headline.
options.risk: Can read cold and technical if the warmth of the families' story is set timidly around it.

raised.raise: Two half-lenses fuse into one full disc at the treatment moment: binocular fusion made visible.
Every lens carries its own engraved caption (credential, service, figure), named like a trial-set power, never an anonymous icon.
State is a mark, not a hue: seen, current and next are rim marks, so the journey reads without colour.
One live signal only: 'Open now' in Hyderabad time is the page's single live presence.
One caption per lens and wide white margins: nothing crowds the glass.
Each treatment step is its own linkable, recoverable state on one continuous sheet.

options.label: Pochampally Ikat
options.lineage: Telangana's tie-dyed double ikat (the weave in Dr. Aloka's saree)
options.thesis: Ikat's feathered, misregistered edges lock into a crisp pattern as warp and weft align: alignment is the page's own weave.
options.viewport: White handloom ground; a wide ikat band whose motifs are blurred and offset, sharpening on scroll; portrait inset in the band.
options.risk: Heritage-textile styling is common among Telangana brands; it can drift into boutique rather than clinic.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.lineage: hazed installation hall with a mirrored half sun
options.thesis: A half disc completes itself in the mirror.
options.viewport: An amber hall with a half sun on the far wall.
options.risk: Amber duotone flattens colour and is too dim for low-vision visitors.
options.case: Loses both axes; also fails the light-theme requirement.
options.kept: Two halves completing into one disc.

options.label: Fashion Mook Spread
options.thesis: Every item named by a hand-drawn ribbon.
options.risk: Gothic fashion register, unrelated to families.
options.kept: Every element carries its own named caption.

options.label: Moiré Gallery
options.thesis: Flat lines that flex with viewing distance.
options.viewport: A white room of strobing black waves.
options.risk: Optical strain is harmful for the clinic's own patients.
options.kept: One caption per canvas, generous white margins.

options.label: ANSI Nightboard
options.risk: Dark and retro; fails the light requirement.
options.kept: Live presence is scarce: one live signal.

options.label: Cutting-Bench Rail
options.thesis: Sections strung as frames on a rail.
options.viewport: An orange field crossed by a perforated rail.
options.risk: Black ground; an editor's tool, not a clinic.
options.kept: State is a mark, not a hue.

options.label: Orizuru Fold Sequence
options.risk: Japanese craft register, low identification for Hyderabad families.
options.kept: Every step a linkable, recoverable state.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A bright trusted-clinic homepage: doctor portrait hero, services, figures, testimonials, map, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Doctor portrait beside headline and Book button, credentials beneath.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other eye hospital in Hyderabad by design.
